text: Canonical protocol in inst/bench/PROTOCOL.md. Shared data/seed/threads/stop/quality via protocol.R and thresholds.json. Entry point Rscript inst/bench/run_protocol.R writes results/current/{meta,runs,quality} after archiving scratch. Invalid-quality rows are rejected (exit nonzero). Tests cover rejection, timing split, metadata, and archive. Local smoke: 6/6 valid conservative rows.
